//: Tests the power-of-two stride-aliasing hypothesis. X row stride is matrix_N*2 bytes. At N=4096 that is 8192 B, which toggles only address bit 13, so an engine's X block hits 2 destination tiles. N=4608 gives a 9216 B stride = group step 9, coprime with 16, so it walks all 16 groups. Same 2-D mapping, same engine count; only the contraction changes.
